justification: `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/metamodel` contains 125 exact-package production classes (127 exact-package Java files total including 2 small tests), totaling about 10,257 LOC / 446,116 bytes. The package spans many responsibilities across declarations, expressions, statements, types, comments, modules, patterns, and literals. `JavaParserMetaModel.java` alone is 179,570 bytes and defines 119 `static final *MetaModel` fields plus large initialization routines, showing strong centralization and a God Component-style concentration of behavior.
